For visitors

Each week’s route is posted in the Meetup comments. Cancellations are posted on the Meetup and the Gung Ho community page. Lights and a helmet are expected as the days shorten.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 18+ mph: brisk — you’ll want some fitness. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Gung Ho Tuesday B+/A- Ride (York Bicycling) group ride

Gung Ho Tuesday B+/A- Ride (York Bicycling) is a road group ride in York, PA. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Cousler Park, paved lot by the bathrooms.

York’s Tuesday-evening road ride, leaving Cousler Park at 5:30 pm. The pace averages 18 mph or more over 30-plus miles. The host says it is no-drop: the group soft-pedals or stops to regroup.
